title: The Melted Candy Bar
description: Engineer Percy Spencer is generally credited with developing the first commercial microwave oven, the Raytheon Radarange, first sold in 1947. While working on a radar set at Raytheon he noticed the microwaves melted a candy bar in his pocket. The first food he cooked on purpose was popcorn; the second was an egg that exploded. Source: Wikipedia, Microwave oven.
